title: Toolshop checkout cart review (P1 conformance cases from docs/test-cases.md; expected to expose open defects, left failing)

scenarios.title: Cart table shows Item, Quantity, Price, Total, Actions

steps.action: Open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart

expected: The cart table header shows the columns Item, Quantity, Price, Total, Actions

scenarios.title: Changing quantity recalculates line and cart totals

steps.action: Open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart
Change the quantity of the product in the cart to 3
expected: The line total equals the unit price multiplied by 3
The cart total equals the unit price multiplied by 3

steps.action: Open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart
Click the delete button of the product in the cart
expected: The product is no longer listed in the cart

steps.action: Open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart
Open the detail page of a second in-stock product and add it to the cart
Click the delete button of the first product in the cart
expected: The cart total equals the unit price of the remaining product

scenarios.title: Cart total reflects the sum of line totals (not 0,00)

steps.action: Open the detail page of an in-stock product and add it to the cart

expected: The cart total equals the sum of the line totals and is not 0,00
